tagline.en: Travel data eSIMs for 140+ destinations with no eKYC
tagline.zh: 覆盖 140+ 目的地的旅行流量 eSIM，无需 eKYC

description.en: esimNB sells data-only travel eSIMs for 140+ countries and regions through its website and an iOS app. Plans run 7-30 days, start at $1.50 for 1GB, and need no eKYC. A rewards/cash-back program is advertised on eligible purchases.
description.zh: esimNB 通过网站与 iOS App 销售覆盖 140+ 国家和地区的纯数据旅行 eSIM，套餐 7-30 天，1GB 起 $1.50，无需 eKYC，并宣称符合条件可获返现奖励。

network.en: Local networks; varies by destination (not disclosed per plan)
network.zh: 目的地本地网络，按套餐未逐一公布

zh: 部分套餐 App 内充值续量

details.en:
esimNB is a new travel eSIM storefront (web + iOS). The App Store listing names the seller as New Access LLC, and the app first appeared in late August 2026 - so the brand has a short public track record.

Application is straightforward: buy a destination pack on the site or in the app, scan the QR code to install, then enable data roaming on arrival. The brand markets no-eKYC checkout and hotspot support, and advertises a cash-back reward on eligible purchases (terms not published on-site).

Prices verified 2026-11-10 by rendering the live destination pages: Japan 1GB/7 days $1.50, 3GB/15 days $3.50, 5GB/30 days $5.50, 10GB/30 days $9.50, 20GB/30 days $16.50, 50GB/30 days $34.50. Thailand and Hong Kong tables sit in the same range (Thailand 10GB $11.50; Hong Kong 10GB $13.00). Some destinations also render a second, higher-priced tier of the same capacity without a plan name - treat the checkout page as the source of truth.

Caveats: all plans are data-only (no number, no SMS), the per-plan underlying network is not disclosed, and the cash-back programme is an official claim without published terms. As with any very new brand, start with a small pack before relying on it for a critical trip.
details.zh:
esimNB 是一个较新的旅行 eSIM 品牌（网站 + iOS App）。App Store 卖家显示为 New Access LLC，App 于 2026 年 8 月底上架——品牌公开运营记录还很短。

购买流程直接：在网站或 App 选目的地套餐、扫码安装、落地开启数据漫游即可。品牌主打免 eKYC 下单与热点共享，并宣称符合条件可获返现（条款未在官网公示）。

价格于 2026-11-10 渲染实际售卖页核验：日本 1GB/7 天 $1.50、3GB/15 天 $3.50、5GB/30 天 $5.50、10GB/30 天 $9.50、20GB/30 天 $16.50、50GB/30 天 $34.50；泰国与香港同区间（泰国 10GB $11.50、香港 10GB $13.00）。注意部分目的地同容量还会渲染出第二个更高价的档位且未标名称——以结算页实际价格为准。

注意点：全部为纯流量（无号码、不能收短信）；单套餐底层网络未披露；返现为官方自述、条款未公示。品牌很新，重要行程建议先用小额套餐试水。
